for, you have a good chance of getting the answers right.Now, let's listen and fill in the blanks with proper numbers.That's task three on your worksheet.Are you ready?The Panama Canal.The Panama need to travel another 15,000 kilometers.So the canal saves a lot of travel time.It takes around 8 to 10 hours to cross the canal.The French started building the canal in 1881, but they couldn't finish it.The project was started again in 1904 by the United States, and the canal was finally finished in 1914.Many people died while they were building the canal, some say up to 25,000.For the rest
